VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report lacks independent verification. While the report describes a plausible fix (upsert with unique constraint to prevent race conditions), there is no attached evidence of:
- CI logs showing all 31 tests passing
- Code diff demonstrating the actual implementation
- Test output or artifacts confirming regression coverage was added

Self-reports alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria requiring objective verification of test passage and code changes. Independent artifacts (CI logs, diffs, test results) are necessary to confirm the fix was actually implemented and validated.
